description: In oidc.rs::try_key: validation.required_spec_claims = ["exp"].iter().map(|s| s.to_string()).collect(); This is equivalent to HashSet::from(["exp".to_string()]) or ["exp".to_owned()].into(). The iterator pattern is unnecessarily verbose for a single-element set. Clippy (unnecessary_to_owned, or clippy::single_element_loop) may flag this.
title: auth: required_spec_claims constructed via iterator; should use HashSet::from directly
